video-processed.eventDescription: One video downloaded, analyzed and delivered with its metadata (any length up to the limit). Failed videos are free.

frame.eventDescription: One frame image saved (JPEG, PNG or WebP). A contact sheet counts as one frame.

scene-minute.eventDescription: One started minute of video analyzed for scene changes (scene mode only; a 10 min 20 s video is 11 minutes).

audio-or-gif.eventDescription: One extra output file: the extracted audio track (M4A, MP3 or Opus) or the animated GIF clip.
